TAMBERLY POWELL, MS, RDN 
Tamberly Powell is a registered dietitian nutritionist 
with a master’s degree in Nutrition and Foodservice 
Management. She is a nutrition faculty member and 
program coordinator for Health and Nutrition at Lane 
Community College. She is passionate about saving 
students’ money by offering low-cost or OER materials 
and engaging students through online learning. She 
enjoys being a mom of two girls, staying active through 
outdoor recreation in the Pacific Northwest, playing 
tennis, and reading a good book.
